methods.label: Compare positions and track signs
methods.explanation:
We need only the order and signs of the numbers, not their exact values. The number line shows
\[
P<Q<0<R<S<T.
\]
Because \(P\) is smaller than \(Q\), the difference \(P-Q\) is negative.

To check the other choices, use the rules that multiplying or dividing two numbers with the same sign gives a positive result, while opposite signs give a negative result. Both \(P\) and \(Q\) are negative, so \(PQ>0\). Also, \(S/Q<0\), so multiplying this quotient by the negative number \(P\) gives \((S/Q)P>0\). Since \(R>0\) and \(PQ>0\), we have \(R/(PQ)>0\). Finally, \(S+T>0\) and \(R>0\), so \((S+T)/R>0\). All denominators are nonzero because \(P,Q<0\) and \(R>0\).

Therefore the only negative expression is \(\boxed{P-Q}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
